args.value: set -euo pipefail; stack="$1"; if [[ ! "$stack" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$ ]]; then echo "Invalid stack name: $stack"; exit 2; fi; source="stacks/development/$stack"; destination="stacks/testing/$stack"; if [[ ! -d "$source" ]]; then echo "Development stack not found: $stack"; exit 2; fi; mkdir -p "$destination"; rsync -av --itemize-changes --exclude=/stack.yml --exclude=/secrets/ --exclude="*override*.yml" --exclude="*override*.yaml" "$source/" "$destination/"
